card.name: The word New starting warning headings
card.fires_on: The word "New" at the start of a warning phrase or heading, right after a section number or condition name, as in "New onset or worsening" or "New Primary Malignancies".

modes.label: New onset or worsening
modes.description: "New" opens the phrase "new onset or worsening" a condition, usually right after a warning heading or condition name.
modes.example: 5.1 Cardiac Toxicities<< New>> onset or worsening of pre-existing cardiac failure

modes.label: New primary malignancies
modes.description: "New" begins a warning heading naming a new disease, right after a section number.
modes.example: 5.1<< New>> Primary Malignancies New primary malignancies

card.plain: It fires on the word "New" when a warning section begins with a new or worsening problem.
